test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If sec² θ + tan² θ = (25)/(18), then the value of sec⁴ θ - tan⁴ θ is:
solution:
**Given:**

sec2 θ + tan2 θ = 25/18

**Formula used:**

sec2 θ - tan2 θ = 1

(sec2 θ + tan2 θ)(sec2 θ - tan2 θ) = sec4 θ - tan4 θ

Calculation

⇒ (sec2 θ + tan2 θ)(sec2 θ - tan2 θ) = sec4 θ - tan4 θ

⇒ 25/18 × 1 = sec4 θ - tan4 θ

⇒ sec4 θ - tan4 θ = 25/18

**The value is 25/18.**
